wars.outcome: Chu destroyed Qi in 445 BC; the page says nothing of the land afterwards.
wars.note: The page is silent on subjection to Song, Lu or Qi. Per Sima Zhen the state moved east in the Spring and Autumn period, and the Shi Mi gui (found 1986) suggests Shandong 'at a much earlier period'; the Kaifeng disc therefore may be too far west for the last decades. The list page puts the final site at Changle County, Shandong.

certainty.note: No Qi boundary is on the page and its location moved; soft throughout.

notes: Pages opened (2 of 1-2): Qi (Henan), List of Zhou dynasty states. Wikidata id left null (unreachable). SLUG qi-henan, from the page title (ea-01-a suggested qi-2); not Qi 齊 (slug qi). START -1046 is a bridge (confidence 1): the page gives only the 11th century BCE. The move to Shandong (Sima Zhen; list: Changle County) is undated, so the chu dossier's Kaifeng disc is kept; a gap-filler with a page on Qi's removal should date it. AREA: none. No ruler list on the page ('a list of rulers with the title gong exists').
